blocks.text: Thank you, the workflow notes came through this morning. Two of the three are here and I have them; that leaves the note for the online returns path still to come whenever your team can lay hands on it. With what we now have, I can close the present-state read on the two largest lines this week.

The half hour you offered on Thursday works well for us. I will send a short agenda the day before so no one is reading the exhibits cold, and I will keep to what the present-state read actually shows rather than getting ahead of the analysis. Jason Torres will join for the first part of the call.

One ask before Thursday. It would help to have you, Melissa Johnson, confirm who owns the online returns process, so I can put a question or two to them directly. For the session itself I have Jason Torres and Deborah Allen on our side, and I will copy them both on the agenda. The picture for {{fact:f:E-2011-001.client}} is coming together, and Thursday should let us agree what to look at next.
